summary.text: Greg Scott is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 54 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served as a Montgomery County magisterial district judge.

paragraphs.text: Scott was born in Norristown, Pennsylvania, graduated from the Renaissance Academy in 2005, earned a B.S. in business and corporate communications from Chestnut Hill College in 2009, and received an M.S. in organizational leadership from the Philadelphia College of Osteopathic Medicine in 2012.

His career experience includes working as a legislative staff member in the U.S. Congress and as chief of staff at a nonprofit before his election as a magisterial district judge in Montgomery County.
He began volunteering as an EMT with the Plymouth Community Ambulance Association at age 17 and, as of 2022, volunteered as a firefighter with Fairmount Engine Company #2.
Scott left the magisterial district court in 2022 and succeeded Robert Brooks in District 54.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Finance, Gaming Oversight, Insurance, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.
